verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents a dedicated Stage environment with its own API, private-link, mTLS and dashboard hosts separate from production. Its transaction simulator runs entirely in Stage and explicitly does not affect production or real user accounts, which covers both parts of the story: a test environment and isolation from production data. missing for 10: self-serve sandbox access (Stage is provisioned through Pomelo's integration team, and the simulator requires an active card and a configured authorization endpoint), independent or hands-on corroboration of the Stage environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Nuestros dominios: Stage: https://api-stage.pomelo.la / Produccion: https://api.pomelo.la
Las simulaciones NO impactan tu ambiente productivo ni generan movimientos reales en las cuentas de tus usuarios. Todas las ejecuciones ocurren en nuestro ambiente de Stage.
